scope: All 63 registered effect classes at 500,000 pixels; defaults plus explicit local input fixtures. Not an exhaustive preset/configuration sweep.
runtime: Python 3.15.0rc2, WSL2, standard asyncio; same isolated environment as report.json.

catalog_method.profiler: profiling.sampling CPU mode, all threads, 1 kHz

audio: Seeded 8-second PCM loop at 30 kHz with 120 BPM drum pulses, changing tones, sweep and broadband noise. Real aubio/melbank/callback processing, no hardware capture. Feed thread is backpressured by slow effect callbacks; callback FPS measures completed processing, not physical-device latency.

fixtures.clone: Generated changing screen frames; no OS capture cost.
fixtures.frontend: Generated RGB events; no browser or inbound websocket cost.
fixtures.blender/radial: Real 1024-pixel Rainbow source virtual. Target render metrics exclude source frames; process CPU includes its small workload.
fixtures.random_flash: Hit probability 1.0 to exercise flashes during short runs.

coverage.initial_harness_failure: Blender fixture passed an unvalidated config dictionary. Corrected and rerun.
replaced_idle_profiles: imagespin: larger source image and rotation

profile_interpretation: Stack shares filter to rendering, temporal effect, audio, preview and websocket stacks, excluding imports/shutdown. Warmup remains included. Shares are sample proportions, not exclusive wall time. Short single-run profiles rank candidates; only the repeated unprofiled comparison supports numerical improvement claims.
shared_optimization: Replace the HSV RGB max reduction and full RGB saturation temporaries with explicit three-channel maxima and reusable one-channel buffers. Preserve arithmetic order and RGB values. Applies to all 11 HSV effects; removes 3 stale type suppressions.
microbenchmark: 500,000 random RGB pixels: saturation/value stage ~19.1 ms before, ~2.7 ms after; identical arrays. This is isolated kernel timing, not end-to-end frame time.
unprofiled_comparison_method: Three fresh workers per effect/version, 2 seconds warmup + 8 seconds measurement. Same 500,000-pixel DDP/full websocket workload and synthetic audio. All throughput gates passed at 10% tolerance.

next_hotspots.finding: Signed out-of-bounds smear accounts for ~58% of active CPU samples; gradient lookup ~15%.
next_hotspots.candidate: Reduce indexed gather/interpolation temporaries in the smear pass while preserving edge/palette rules.

next_hotspots.finding: Noise draw/generation and gradient lookup dominate; gradient lookup alone is ~37% of Noise and ~22% of Smoke active samples.
next_hotspots.candidate: Investigate gradient gather layout and reusable coordinate buffers before changing noise algorithms.

next_hotspots.finding: Sawtooth/triangle waveform machinery and repeated array sine calls remain expensive after the shared HSV improvement.
next_hotspots.candidate: Specialize the fixed-width triangle path with equivalence tests; avoid general waveform broadcasting/selection work.

next_hotspots.finding: DDP packet sending, JSON encoding and shared render/audio locking remain system-level limits.
next_hotspots.candidate: Investigate output batching and ownership/locking only with delivery and audio correctness tests.

validation: 123 focused tests pass on Python 3.12 and 3.15.
All 63 cases validate websocket RGB payloads and receive complete DDP frames.
All 11 affected HSV effects pass the post-change streaming/profile sweep.
Scalar-reference tests cover shared HSV saturation/value output, including wrapped hues and values outside the nominal saturation range.
Ruff, ClassVar audit and Pyrefly stale-baseline checks pass.
limitations: One machine, one configuration per effect; not all presets, resolutions, drivers or hardware.
500,000 full-preview pixels deliberately bypass the product preview cap inside the worker.
Receiver/sampler CPU is excluded; UDP complete-frame rates expose loopback drops.
Generated inputs omit real capture, browser and network-source overhead.
Python 3.15 remains experimental; project Python support metadata is unchanged.
commands: python3.15 tools/pixel_bench.py --effects all --synthetic-audio --fixtures --sampling cpu --loops standard --streams full --seconds 5 --repeats 1 --keep-going --output /tmp/catalog.jsonl
